column1: # The line pages find each other on: where it listens (a name that
# stands for more than one address is listened on at each, so a page
# reaches it whichever it tries first), the first part
# of a room's path, the cookie a page is known by and what follows its
# value, what a guest is called and how their id begins, the pages that
# may call from a browser (a scheme and a name, with any port), and the
# names of two settings of the system: a JSON list of ICE servers, and
# a list of origins, with commas, that replaces the ones here.
# When the line stands behind one that knows who people are (Phiora,
# which keeps the accounts), that one says who each page belongs to:
# the heads it says it in (the shared word, who, their name, their
# handle, each with its bytes written as %XX), and the name of the
# system's setting that holds the word. With no word set nobody is
# believed, and every page is a guest.
